sanskrit: somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīm amīvā yā no gayam āviveśa | bādhethāṃ dveṣo nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cid enaḥ pra mumuktam asmat ||
english: O Soma and Rudra, tear asunder the widespread disease that has entered our house; drive back enmity and dissolution to the far distance; release even the sin that has been committed from us.

sanskrit: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāv iha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ | pra ṇo muñcataṃ duritād avadyād gopāyataṃ naḥ sumanasyamānau ||
english: Sharp-weaponed, sharp-bolted, gracious pair — O Soma and Rudra, be well merciful to us here; release us from distress and from blame; guard us with minds well disposed toward us.

sanskrit: somārudrā dhārayethām asuryaṃ pra vām iṣṭvā varam aśnavātai | yuvaṃ no dhattām iha bheṣajāni pra yacchataṃ vṛṣaṇā jetvāni ||
english: O Soma and Rudra, hold fast your divine lordship; having sacrificed to you, may we attain the boon; do you two bestow upon us healing medicines here; grant us conquering gifts, O bulls.

sanskrit: somārudrā yuvam asmāsv antas tanūṣu viśvā bheṣajāni dhattam | ava syataṃ muñcataṃ kiṃ cid eno aṅgeṣu baddham uta yadṛśatvi ||
english: O Soma and Rudra, place all remedies within us, within our bodies; loosen and release whatever sin is bound in the limbs, and whatever has become visible.

sanskrit: ghṛtasya jūtiḥ samanā sadevāḥ saṃvatsaraṃ haviṣā vardhayantī | śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ prāṇo acchinno no astv acchinnā vayam āyuṣo varcasaḥ ||
english: The impulse of ghee, together with the gods in union, nourishing throughout the year with oblation — may ear, eye, and breath be uncut for us; may we be uncut of lifespan and radiant vigor.

sanskrit: upāsmān prāṇo hvayatām upa vayaṃ prāṇaṃ havāmahe | varco jagrāha pṛthivy antarikṣaṃ varcaḥ somo bṛhaspatir vidhartā ||
english: May breath call to us; we in turn invoke breath; earth has seized luster, the atmosphere luster; Soma and Bṛhaspati are the ordaining dispensers of luster.

sanskrit: varcaso dyāvāpṛthivī saṃgrahaṇī babhūvatur varco gṛhītvā pṛthivīm anu saṃ carema | yaśasā gāvo gopatim upa tiṣṭhanty āyatīr yaśo gṛhītvā pṛthivīm anu saṃ carema ||
english: Heaven and earth have become the twin repositories of luster; having seized luster, may we travel together along the earth. The cows, approaching with glory, attend the lord of the herd; having seized glory, may we travel together along the earth.

sanskrit: vrajaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ sa hi vo nṛpāṇo varmā sīvyadhvaṃ bahulā pṛthūni | puraḥ kṛṇudhvam āyasīr adhṛṣṭā mā vaḥ susroc camaso dṛṃhatā tam ||
english: Build the cattle-pen, for he is your protector; stitch many broad coats of armor; make iron fortresses unassailable; let not your cup overflow — make it firm.

sanskrit: nyag vāto vāti nyak tapati sūryaḥ | nīcīnam aghnyā duhe nyag bhavatu te viṣam ||
english: The wind blows downward, the sun burns downward; the inviolable cow milks downward — may your venom go downward and be spent.

sanskrit: ni gāvo goṣṭhe asadan ni vatsā adhi tantyām | ny ūrmayo nadīnāṃ ni śuṣmā arasānām ||
english: The cows have settled in the cowpen, the calves at the tether; the waves of rivers have subsided, the vigor of the venom-spent serpents has subsided.

sanskrit: ahīnām ahikānāṃ saṃ hi śīrṣāṇy agrabham | hradaṃ sahasrabāhuḥ paretya vy anijam aher viṣam ||
english: I have indeed grasped together the heads of serpents and their offspring; reaching the thousand-armed pool, I washed out the venom of the serpent.

sanskrit: turāṇām aturāṇāṃ viśām urukṣitām uta | kṛṇomi tubhyaṃ bheṣajam āheyam arasaṃ viṣam ||
english: For the swift and for the slow, for the widely-dwelling peoples as well — I make for you the remedy: the serpent-born poison rendered powerless.

sanskrit: imā ūrū savāsinau varcasāñje ahaṃ mama | nāma hy enayor veda yathā na bahavo viduḥ ||
english: These two thighs of mine, well-clad, I anoint with luster for myself; for I know the secret name of these two as few others know it.

sanskrit: varcasāpīnā pṛthivī sūryeṇottabhitā dyauḥ | tviṣiṃ yāṃ paśyāmo vāte tāṃ ni yacche mamorvoḥ ||
english: Earth is filled full with luster; heaven is propped up by the sun; the splendor that we behold in the wind — that I direct down into my two thighs.

sanskrit: veda vai vāṃ nāmadheyaṃ jigīvām̐ aparājitam | prajāṃ ca bahvīm ā śāse rāṣṭraṃ cendrābhirakṣitam ||
english: I know indeed your secret name, O conquering, unconquered pair; I pray for abundant offspring and a realm guarded by Indra.

sanskrit: viduṣī vāṃ nāmadheyam aśvinā sāraghaṃ madhu | sūrya iva cakṣur bhūtānāṃ prajāṃ dhārayataṃ mayi rayiṃ dhārayataṃ mayi ||
english: Knowing your secret name, O Aśvins — sweet as the honey of the bee; like the eye of the sun for all living beings — hold offspring steadfast in me, hold wealth steadfast in me.

sanskrit: śatapāśāṃ vi tanomy ūrubhyāṃ jaghanena ca | tasmin yo badhyate bandhe sa me astv anyakṣakaḥ ||
english: I spread out a hundred-snared net across the thighs and across the loins; whoever is bound in that binding — let him be impotent toward me.
